title: Three Autumns and One Short Twig
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：leaf　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leaf 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the gardener ① collected the leaf that no child in the garden would have recorded, and he said the collecting was the whole of the autumn. The ② leaf, meaning the blade itself and not the twig, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; a leaf, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ leaf in that garden had the same short twig beside it, and the ④ leaf at the far wall, meaning the vein they kept for the children to trace and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A leaf, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the gardener said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the leaf was the whole of the matter, meaning the sign and not the blade. The ⑥ leaf, meaning the sign and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; leaf, he said, is either something you collect or the only word that means both a blade and a sign. He said the sign is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ leaf had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short twig. The ⑧ leaf of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in October, was one garden and three autumns of recording; leaf, he said, is either the vein at the far wall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ leaf I remember is the blade recorded in the notebook, which closed in 1973 and is still recorded as the quietest in the garden. A ⑩ leaf, my mother said in 1975, is the only blade that improves by being recorded; every leaf, she said, is a sign that has agreed to look like a blade. She said the sign was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 叶子；叶（指园子里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 叶子；叶（指那片叶子本身，与细枝相对）
C. 固定搭配：collect the leaf 采集这片叶子
D. n. 叶子；叶（指留给孩子们描的那道叶脉那一片）
E. n. 草木之事（抽象总称，指一处园子的叶子之事）
F. n. 叶子；叶（指标本册里写到、被记载的的那一片）
G. n. 征兆、时节（指一件事里人人都拾却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 时节（抽象总称，指人人都拾却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: collected the leaf that no child in the garden would have recorded
The leaf, meaning the blade itself and not the twig
the leaf at the far wall
the leaf was the whole of the matter
the leaf had become a line in a notebook
The leaf of the whole thing
A leaf, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: collect the leaf 意为“采集这片叶子”，1966 年那位园丁把园子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一片叶子做了一遍。
leaf 意为“叶子；叶”，指那片叶子本身而不是细枝，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
leaf 意为“叶子；叶”，指园子里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一根细细的枝条。
leaf 意为“叶子；叶”，指最远那堵墙头留给孩子们描的那道叶脉那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
leaf 意为“征兆、时节”，指一件事里人人都拾却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个征兆就是那件事的全部。
leaf 意为“时节”，指人人都拾却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片叶子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
leaf 意为“叶子；叶”，指标本册里写到、被记载的的那一片，到 1971 年这一片成了标本册里的一行。
leaf 意为“草木之事”，园丁十月写道，整件事的叶子之事是一处园子和三个秋天的记载。
leaf 意为“叶子；叶”，我记得的是标本册里记载过的那一片，1973 年夹好了，至今仍被说成园子里最安静的一片。
leaf 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，叶子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的叶子。
